cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Terms and Conditions
cards.instruction: Treat every offer, favor, feeling, and apology as a negotiation.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Mate's rates, as you say. Two lifts instead of one for borrowing my ladder.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mate's rates means less, not more. I only need it five minutes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Less cash, yes. One lift, then, and tell your wife my roses have improved.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can't you lend it because we're friends?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Certainly. Say that to your wife too and we can drop the lift. I'll take a public endorsement of the friendship.

reason: Use an explicit misunderstood copied action or phrase, with practical B contributions shaping the same Drive across all five turns.
